description: Grow the cmd tool's deps. Pass spec_key (a cabinet buildspecs/ yaml you authored) to start a layer build, or build_id to poll; on success the layer attaches to cmd automatically (max 5).

spec_key.description: Cabinet key under buildspecs/. The spec must install into layer/ and artifact layer.zip (bin/ inside lands on PATH).

build_id.description: A build id returned by a prior call. Polls status; publishes + attaches the layer when SUCCEEDED.
